tasks.label: Claude
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && source ~/.profile_env && echo INSIDE_AWS_VAULT:$PWD && echo CLAUDE_PATH:$(command -v claude || true) && aws-vault exec noone --duration 12h -- zsh -ic 'claude --effort high --model fable --append-system-prompt-file ~/dev/ibr/IBR/IBR.md --dangerously-skip-permissions --continue || claude --effort high --model fable --append-system-prompt-file ~/dev/ibr/IBR/IBR.md --dangerously-skip-permissions'

tasks.label: Terminal
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && source ~/.profile_env && aws-vault exec noone --duration 12h -- zsh -i
